title: ‘The Pitt’ Star Noah Wyle Was Offered Roles in ‘Saving Private Ryan’ and ‘Good Night, and Good Luck’ but ‘Couldn’t Get Out’ of Filming ‘ER’
content:
ByJack Dunn

“The Pitt” starNoah Wylerecently told the“Still Here Hollywood” podcastthat he missed out on roles in “Saving Private Ryan” and “Good Night, and Good Luck” because he couldn’t get out of filming the long-running medical series “ER.”

When asked if he had any roles that got away, Wyle said, “Yeah, tons. Happens all the time. We talked about a couple of them, actually. ‘Good Night, and Good Luck,’ George [Clooney] offered me a part in that. I couldnt’ get out of ‘ER’ to do it. I was offered the part of Private Ryan in ‘Saving Private Ryan,’ couldn’t get out of ‘ER’ to do it.”

Wyle added that he was in some ways glad he missed out on those parts, because the people who got them made the best of the opportunity.

“I almost am glad that I didn’t do them, because, you know, those guys made those parts,” he said. “Matt Damon was Private Ryan. There were two. I got offered the part of Upham, which was Jeremy Davies’ part, and he was so phenomenal in that I couldn’t imagine doing anything close to what he did.”

Wyle is currently starring in another hit medical drama, “The Pitt,” which wrapped up its second season on HBO Max in April. Production on Season 3 began in June and is set to take place on a day in November. “The Pitt” Season 1 took home five Emmy awards in 2025, including outstanding drama series and lead actor in a drama for Wyle for his role as Dr. Michael “Robby” Robinavitch.
title_zh: 《皮特(The Pitt)》明星諾亞·懷利(Noah Wyle)曾獲得《拯救大兵瑞恩(Saving Private Ryan)》和《晚安，好運(Good Night, and Good Luck)》的角色，但因為無法脫身拍攝《急診室的春天(ER)》。
content_zh:
由Jack Dunn報導

《皮特醫院》(The Pitt) 的明星諾亞·懷爾(Noah Wyle)最近在《仍在好萊塢》(Still Here Hollywood) 播客中透露，他錯過了《拯救大兵瑞恩》(Saving Private Ryan) 和《晚安，好運》(Good Night, and Good Luck) 的角色，因為他無法脫身拍攝長期播出的醫療劇《急診室的春天》(ER)。

當被問及是否有錯過的角色時，懷爾表示：“是的，很多。這種事時常發生。我們其實談過幾個。‘晚安，好運’，喬治·克隆尼(George Clooney)給我提供了一個角色。我無法脫身去拍《急診室的春天》來做這個。我被提供了《拯救大兵瑞恩》中瑞恩下士的角色，但也無法脫身去拍。”

懷爾補充說，他在某種程度上很高興自己錯過了這些角色，因為獲得這些角色的人都充分利用了這個機會。

“我幾乎很高興我沒有參與，因為你知道，那些家伙演出了那些角色，”他說。“馬特·達蒙(Matt Damon)就是瑞恩下士。還有兩個角色。我被提供了烏帕姆的角色，那是傑瑞米·戴維斯(Jeremy Davies)的角色，他在那部電影中的表現非常出色，我無法想像能做到他所做的任何事。”

懷爾目前正在主演另一部熱門醫療劇《皮特醫院》(The Pitt)，該劇在HBO Max的第二季已於四月完結。第三季的製作於六月開始，預計將在十一月的某一天拍攝。《皮特醫院》第一季在2025年獲得五項艾美獎，包括傑出劇情系列和最佳劇情類劇集男主角，懷爾因其飾演的邁克爾·“羅比”·羅賓納維奇醫生而獲獎。
